about: The communio of the formulary “11th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with first fruits of all your produce. Then will your barns be filled with grain, with new wine your vats will overflow.

w015.gloss: condition of being imbued with a color to saturation

w018.gloss: of/connected with/belonging to a wine/oil press
